description:
Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add:
Package owns generic namespace routing, compatible serialization, snapshot selection and confirmation sequencing currently in ZAQ Storage/Session. Host selects namespace policy and supplies typed trusted authorization, durable persistence, connector-confirmation and runtime-start callbacks with opaque context. Authorization runs before each protected operation, including RAM read/write/seed/clear. Stop protocol writes before freezing; persist durable snapshot with stable attempt id; retry failures from frozen state. After successful host save, seed RAM once then start saved runtime. Report saved/runtime_pending after seed/start failure. Preserve identity-presented guard, idempotent confirm and clear-both-stores behavior; no late snapshot resurrection. Handle uncertain persistence outcomes with the same attempt id. Raw secrets only cross trusted internal callbacks, never public status/logs/errors. Retain existing encrypted encoding or explicit compatible codec.

Tests to add before implementation:
Before code: real package composition with fake host boundary callbacks; authorization ordering for RAM/durable operations; revoked/wrong profile; callback exceptions/timeouts/invalid returns; persistence failure and lost-success-response retry; duplicate confirm; expiry/cancel during save; identity changed; post-save seed/start failure; clear partial failure; stale snapshot; secret-redaction and isolation properties.

Branches/paths validated:
Durable/volatile; allowed/denied; mutable/frozen/saved; save failed/committed/uncertain; seed retry; runtime_pending; stale generation.

Mocking plan:
Real internal collaborators; inject external transport/host-callback edges only. Isolated BEAMs for global Mnesia. Explicit config/clock/dependency options.

Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content:
Package storage composition and typed callback contracts, confirmation sequence and generic-host examples.

Action reuse assessment:
Reuse Amarula callbacks, GuardedStorage, Mnesia seed-once and upstream temporary/session primitives. Local-only generic orchestration; existing host ConfirmLinkedDevice Action still owns the database transaction and permissions.

Validation and E2E:
Read owning AGENTS.md and ZAQ workflow, action-reuse, testing, system-config and documentation policies as applicable. Use real internal state/process/DB boundaries; mock only external WhatsApp transport or package host-callback boundary in upstream standalone tests. Isolate global Mnesia tests in separate BEAMs. Runtime dependency seams use explicit public options. Preserve current UI journeys; run relevant existing tests, no new feature E2E authoring unless scope changes and the required UX approval is recorded. Follow post-review coverage and final validation gates; no automatic commit/push/publication.
